shortBulletSummary: Crypto Markets See Downturn. Bitcoin dropped 3.8% to $77,814, with the overall crypto market capitalization down 2.9% in the last 24 hours.
Fed Chair Warsh's Inflation Remarks. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's comments about needing "more work to do" to fight inflation caused Bitcoin's recent rally to cool off.
Strong ETF Inflows Continue. US Spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded over $3 billion in net inflows in August, marking nine consecutive days of positive inflows.
Jackson Hole Focuses on Crypto. The Jackson Hole Economic Symposium included cryptocurrencies and stablecoins on its official agenda for the first time, discussing financial innovation and policy.
